name: apus
description: Live preview and debugging for iOS apps via Apus MCP server

apus.wsHost.description: WebSocket host address for the Apus server

apus.wsPort.description: WebSocket port for the Apus server

apus.autoConnect.description: Automatically connect to the Apus server on startup

apus.screenshotFps.description: Frames per second for live preview screenshots

apus.screenshotScale.description: Screenshot scale factor (0.0–2.0). Use 2.0 for maximum sharpness.

apus.screenshotQuality.description: JPEG quality for screenshots (0.0–1.0). Use 1.0 for maximum readability.

apus.idleScreenshotFps.description: Reduced FPS used when live preview is idle

apus.interactionBoostMs.description: Milliseconds to keep high FPS after user interaction

apus.interactionStrictMode.description: Require semantic UI targets for coordinate-based interactions (identifier/label). If disabled, falls back to raw coordinates.

apus.logBufferSize.description: Maximum number of log entries to keep in memory

apus.previewChangesScriptPath.description: Script (with args) for manual Preview Changes / Deploy (Cmd+Shift+R). Default: deploy only.

apus.previewChangesTimeoutSec.description: Timeout in seconds for the Preview Changes command.

apus.previewChangesRevealOutput.description: Automatically reveal the Preview Changes output channel when the command starts.

apus.autoPreviewOnSave.description: Automatically compile after matching files are saved.

apus.autoPreviewDebounceMs.description: Debounce window in milliseconds before auto Preview Changes runs after save.

apus.autoPreviewCooldownSec.description: Minimum cooldown between auto Preview Changes runs.

apus.autoPreviewRevealOutput.description: Reveal the Preview Changes output channel for auto-triggered runs.

apus.autoPreviewShowSuccessNotification.description: Show success notifications for auto-triggered builds.

apus.autoPreviewScriptPath.description: Script (with args) for auto-compile on save. Default: build only (no simulator install).

apus.autoPreviewFileGlobs.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns that trigger auto Preview Changes on save.

scripts.test: npm run build && npx mocha dist/test/apus-client.test.js
